# Medical Tourism Packages

> > Comprehensive medical tourism platform connecting international patients with JCI-accredited hospitals across Latin America for affordable, world-class surgical and dental procedures.

Medical Tourism Packages specializes in facilitating medical travel to Colombia, Panama, Mexico, and Costa Rica, offering procedures from orthopedic surgery and joint replacements to cosmetic procedures and dental work. The platform features JCI-accredited hospitals in major cities like Bogotá, Medellín, Cali, and Panama City, with cost savings of 50-80% compared to US and Canadian prices.

## Key Topics

- JCI-accredited hospitals
- Medical tourism in Latin America
- Colombia (Bogotá, Medellín, Cali)
- Panama medical facilities
- Mexico dental and cosmetic surgery
- Cost savings (50-80% vs US/Canada)
- Joint replacement surgery
- Orthopedic procedures
- Cosmetic and plastic surgery
- Dental implants and veneers
- International patient services
- Board-certified surgeons
- Medical travel packages
- Caribbean medical tourism
